purpose: Measure whether independently qualified sequence, depth, and width bundles cooperate, interfere, or become redundant without assigning bundle effects to their internal subcomponents.
entry_gate: one sequence bundle is frozen after its ordered component program and promotion gates
one depth bundle is frozen after AttnRes block-count and depth/width promotion gates
one width bundle is frozen after conventional MoE, latent, normalization, activation, balancing, geometry, and hardware gates
every axis has a matched absence control and immutable export/runtime identity
the evaluation manifest, data cells, cube analysis, and resource envelope are frozen before any cube output

sequence.absence: its strongest promoted or conservative sequence control at matched geometry
sequence.non_attribution: the cube cannot credit KDA, cache representation, HCA, CSA, local window, ratio, or placement individually

depth.presence: the selected AttnRes formulation, block count, and retuned depth/width geometry
depth.absence: a separately retuned standard-residual geometry under the same active parameter and compute budget
depth.non_attribution: a naive residual swap at the AttnRes-optimal shape is not the absence control

width.presence: the selected stable expert formulation and geometry
width.absence: parameter/FLOP-view-matched dense SwiGLU with the same sequence/depth parent
width.non_attribution: the cube cannot credit latent projection, normalization, bounded activation, balancing, or expert count individually

discovery_cube.coding: 0 is the frozen matched absence control and 1 is the frozen selected axis bundle
discovery_cube.pairing: all eight cells share initialization seed, packed-data order, token budget, optimizer, tokenizer, evaluation, and hardware within each paired cell
discovery_cube.scale: 130M-170M active-parameter discovery at the frozen proxy token budget
discovery_cube.no_cell_selection: all 24 runs execute regardless of interim quality unless a preregistered integrity or safety failure occurs

contrast_contract.direction: candidate presence minus absence; negative loss is beneficial
contrast_contract.estimation: form every contrast within seed/data cell, then report mean, sample standard deviation, and one-sided or two-sided 95% Student-t bounds over the three paired contrasts
contrast_contract.regression_view: report the equivalent saturated pair-blocked S*D*W model as a descriptive consistency check, not as a substitute for paired contrasts

decision_thresholds.pairwise_gate: the upper one-sided paired 95% bound for every predeclared pairwise loss interaction must be at or below 0.01 nats and every source bound at or below 0.02
decision_thresholds.three_way_gate: report the two-sided 95% bound and require its upper one-sided bound to clear the same harmful margin before retaining all three axes
decision_thresholds.multiplicity: apply Holm correction across SD, SW, DW, and the three-way interaction for any superiority or antagonism claim; source guardrails remain an intersection gate
decision_thresholds.systems: quality-passing combinations must also preserve each axis's already frozen realized systems threshold; interaction overhead is measured rather than inferred
decision_thresholds.inconclusive: failure to detect interaction is not synergy or independence

matching_views: time and energy to one control-locked quality target

sequence_depth: AttnRes source age around recurrent/global integration slots
KDA overwrite and global-source recall under routed depth
sequence_width: expert choice by dependency distance and selected source
routing load when compressed/sparse sequence paths activate
depth_width: expert choice by residual source age
gradient/load tails under AttnRes activation storage
three_way: joint failure cases with route, payload, residual source, and expert identity
memory/communication overlap among sequence state, depth activations, and expert dispatch

axis_removals: remove the selected sequence bundle using its matched absence control
replace depth routing with the retuned standard-residual geometry
replace the expert bundle with matched dense SwiGLU

subcomponent_removals.sequence: remove each retained cache, HCA, CSA, local, ratio/placement novelty under its own previously qualified control
subcomponent_removals.depth: remove content dependence with the static-depth control and replace selected block count/formulation separately
subcomponent_removals.width: remove latent projection, normalization, bounded activation, balancing, and geometry changes one at a time

final_removal_program.retain_rule: a component remains only if its conditional removal either causes a preregistered quality failure or removes a realized systems benefit that clears its applicable threshold while quality remains non-inferior
final_removal_program.simpler_tie_rule: if the simpler removal passes all quality floors and the retained component does not clear its systems/quality contribution threshold, delete the component
final_removal_program.new_training: removals are matched trained arms unless a separately justified surgical inference ablation has been proven to answer the same causal question

scale_transfer.discovery: the complete 24-run cube diagnoses interactions but cannot promote a combination
scale_transfer.finalist: confirm every interaction that changes retention and all full-model removal effects on six paired cells
scale_transfer.medium: repeat the selected full combination and strongest simpler removal on three paired medium-scale cells with no primary-effect sign reversal
scale_transfer.target_sentinel: one matched target-scale pair detects integration reversal only and has no population-equivalence authority

decision.next_action: after all three axes independently qualify, freeze exact presence/absence config hashes and resource cost for all eight cells
